method: builtin image_gen, one full-character generation per pose using accepted contact as anatomical master and old pose as action-only reference; source PNG bytes preserved

visual_review.scope: Both complete native generated outputs visually inspected, compared with approved contact and rejected poses. Static source only; no runtime composite or animation test.
observations: Both revised poses now use the accepted right-facing oblique pelvis and staggered leg depth instead of the rejected frontal spread thighs.
Near thigh-knee-calf-ankle-shoe reads as one continuous limb; far upper thigh is obscured by dress/near leg and rear shoe is smaller and higher.
Approach has relaxed reaching fingers; withdraw has far hand near chin and near hand lowered. Hands use natural overlap, not all digits forced visible.
Dark face/chin, horns, wings, tail and dress remain present; no evident new detached limb in the full-view inspection.
limits: Not a proof of anatomically exact skeleton or every small ornament topology.
Generated line/colour changes outside requested anatomy are present; no pixel lock claimed.
Actual render anchor coordinates and transition continuity must be remeasured after user selection.
Low-alpha edge noise reaches canvas bounds; opaque silhouette above alpha 32 remains inside margins. Runtime transparency on light and dark scene backgrounds has not been verified.
